basic.name: Fan of Knives
basic.description:
Deal 152~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in a crescent area.

Hitting at least 2 enemy Heroes with Fan of Knives reduces its cooldown to 0.5 seconds, and refunds its Mana cost.

basic.name: Umbral Bind
basic.description: Maiev's next Basic Attack cleaves and applies a tether to enemy Heroes hit for 2.5 seconds. If a tethered Hero moves too far from Maiev, they are pulled toward her, dealing 110~~0.04~~ damage and breaking the tether.

basic.name: Spirit of Vengeance
basic.description: Send a shadow of Maiev outward that will return to its cast location, dealing 150~~0.04~~ damage to enemies along both paths. If an enemy Hero is hit, reduce the cooldown by 4 seconds.

basic.name: Umbral Bind
basic.description: Maiev's next Basic Attack cleaves and applies a tether to enemy Heroes hit for 2.5 seconds. If a tethered Hero moves too far from Maiev, they are pulled toward her, dealing 110~~0.04~~ damage and breaking the tether.

basic.name: Blink
basic.description: Teleport to the Spirit of Vengeance, consuming it.

heroic.name: Containment Disc
heroic.description:
Throw a glaive in the target direction. If an enemy Hero is hit, Containment Disc can be reactivated to remove their vision and Time Stop them for 4 seconds. Leaving Containment Silences the enemy Hero for 1.5 seconds.

Containment Disc automatically activates 6 seconds after hitting a Hero.

heroic.name: Warden's Cage
heroic.description: Summon 8 Warden Avatars as a cage around Maiev. After 1.5 seconds, enemy Heroes that come in contact with an Avatar consume it and are knocked to the center of the cage. Warden Avatars last 5 seconds.

heroic.name: Contain
heroic.description: Activate to remove the target's vision and Time Stop them for 4 seconds.

trait.name: Vault of the Wardens
trait.description:
Leap into the air, becoming Immune to all hostile effects for 0.75 seconds.

After reaching Level 20, Vault of the Wardens gains an additional charge.

activable.name: Naisha's Memento
activable.description:
Activate to make primary Basic Attacks bounce between nearby enemies up to 2 times. Lasts 8 seconds.

Recharge Naisha's Memento by hitting at least 2 Heroes with a single Fan of Knives.

activable.name: Shadow Orb: Huntress
activable.description:
Activate to increase Movement Speed and Attack Speed by 40% for 5 seconds.

Recharge Shadow Orb by dealing Physical Damage to enemy Heroes 10 times.

activable.name: Shadow Orb: Shadow Strike
activable.description:
Activate to deal 75~~0.04~~ damage to an enemy Hero, Slowing them by 30% and reducing their Armor by 20 for 4 seconds.

Recharge Shadow Orb by dealing Spell Damage to enemy Heroes 10 times.

activable.name: Shadow Orb: Vengeance
activable.description:
Activate to reset the cooldown of Spirit of Vengeance.

Recharge Shadow Orb by damaging enemy Heroes with Spirit of Vengeance 5 times.

level1.name: Bonds of Justice
level1.description:
Quest: Each tether applied to a secondary target of Umbral Bind permanently increases Umbral Bind's pull damage by 15.

Reward: After applying 5 tethers to secondary targets, increase Umbral Bind's pull damage by 75.

Reward: After applying 10 tethers to secondary targets, increase Umbral Bind's cleave damage by 30%.

level1.name: Pursuit of Vengeance
level1.description: Each Hero tethered by Umbral Bind reduces the cooldown of Spirit of Vengeance by 2.5 seconds and each Hero hit by Spirit of Vengeance reduces the cooldown of Umbral Bind by 1 second.

level1.name: Naisha's Memento
level1.description:
Activate to make primary Basic Attacks bounce between nearby enemies up to 2 times. Lasts 8 seconds.

Recharge Naisha's Memento by hitting at least 2 Heroes with a single Fan of Knives.

level4.name: Pin Down
level4.description:
Quest: Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single Fan of Knives.

Reward: Increase Fan of Knives damage by 35%.

Reward: Each additional time 3 enemy Heroes are hit by a single Fan of Knives, gain an additional 5% damage, up to 50%.

Reward: Hit 4 enemy Heroes with a single Fan of Knives to instantly gain all Rewards.

level4.name: Blade Dance
level4.description: Using Fan of Knives deals 50~~0.04~~ Physical Damage to enemies around Maiev.

level4.name: Sudden Vengeance
level4.description: After blinking with Spirit of Vengeance, the shadow explodes, damaging all nearby enemy Heroes for 6% of their maximum Health.

level7.name: Elune's Wrath
level7.description: Hitting at least 2 Heroes with a single Fan of Knives causes the next Fan of Knives to drop a star on targets that deals 77~~0.04~~ damage when it impacts.

level7.name: Bonds of Corruption
level7.description: Enemy Heroes pulled by Umbral Bind have their Armor reduced by 15 and are Slowed by 25% for 3 seconds

level7.name: Ruthless Spirit
level7.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Spirit of Vengeance increases all damage Maiev deals by 15% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 30%.

level10.name: Containment Disc
level10.description:
Throw a glaive in the target direction. If an enemy Hero is hit, Containment Disc can be reactivated to remove their vision and Time Stop them for 4 seconds. Leaving Containment Silences the enemy Hero for 1.5 seconds.

Containment Disc automatically activates 6 seconds after hitting a Hero.

level10.description: Summon 8 Warden Avatars as a cage around Maiev. After 1.5 seconds, enemy Heroes that come in contact with an Avatar consume it and are knocked to the center of the cage. Warden Avatars last 5 seconds.

level13.name: Bladed Armor
level13.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Fan of Knives grants 5 Armor for 5 seconds, up to 20 Armor.

level13.name: Chain Gang
level13.description: Tethering at least 2 enemy Heroes with Umbral Bind grants 35 Armor for 4 seconds.

level13.name: Shadow Armor
level13.description: Blink grants 20 Armor for 3.5 seconds. Maiev's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes refresh this duration.

level16.name: Vengeful Knives
level16.description: Dealing damage to enemy Heroes causes the next cast of Fan of Knives that hits enemy Heroes to deal 1% maximum Health as bonus damage, up to 5%.

level16.name: Cruel Chain
level16.description: Umbral Bind grants 25% Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds. In addition, each time Maiev deals damage to tethered targets, Umbral Bind's pull damage to all targets is increased by 30%, up to 150%.

level16.name: Armored Assault
level16.description: While Maiev has positive Armor of any kind, all Physical Damage dealt is increased by 25%.

level20.description:

Recharge Shadow Orb by damaging enemy Heroes with Spirit of Vengeance 5 times.
